Appuie dans l'espace, tire en arrière co: Press in space, pull back like a slingshot and let go: the dotted line shows the path, bent by gravity. Every pixel torn off becomes debris: slow, it falls back and sticks again; fast, it flies off into space. The thinner the planet gets, the weaker its pull. The comet goes right through, the bomb lands then explodes, the black hole swallows everything near it. One star unlocks the next planet. With the keyboard: arrows for the crosshair, A and E for the angle, hold Space for power.
Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Jeu de destruction de planètes en pixel: Pixel art planet destruction game: each planet is made of thousands of pixels (crust, rock, magma, core) and every pixel torn off becomes debris pulled by gravity. Asteroids, comets that go right through, time bombs and black holes, in limited supply: seven planets to destroy, three stars each.
